10001.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 3.5 miles south-southwest of Smyrna had 34.19 inches. August was the wettest month at 5.91 inches, and 2.97 of that came on Aug 21, the biggest single day. The longest dry stretch ran 11 days, Jan 27 to Feb 6. On the days both years reported, this year is 2.53 inches less than last year.

10005.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Georgetown-Delaware Coastal Airport sits 2.97 inches less than a usual year. August was the wettest month at 5.73 inches, and Aug 3 brought the biggest single day with 2.08 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 8 days, Jan 27 to Feb 3. Last year by this date the gauge had 6.55 inches more.
